info.name: OCHF API - Off-Campus Hostel Finder (Group 16)
info.description:
Postman Collection for Group 16 Capstone Project - Off-Campus Hostel Finder (OCHF) Backend API.

Covers Auth, OTP Verification, Properties, Inspection Slots, Bookings, Transactions, Reviews, Reports, Admin Moderation, and Notifications.

item.name: 1. Authentication & OTP
item.description: Registration, Login, User profile, and Student email OTP verification

request.description: Register a new student. Returns JWT token and sets nextStep to 'otp_verification'.
Register a property provider/landlord.
Authenticate student and save token to {{studentToken}}.
Authenticate provider and save token to {{providerToken}}.
Authenticate admin and save token to {{adminToken}}.
Returns profile and verification status of currently authenticated user.
Dispatches 6-digit email OTP (TTL: 10 mins). In development, code is logged to the server console.
Resend verification code (subject to 60-second cooldown and max 5 sends/hour).
Submit 6-digit OTP to verify email. If OTP_AUTO_VERIFY is enabled, marks student profile as verified.

item.name: 2. Properties
item.description: Listing creation, distance computation, search, filtering, and detail endpoints

request.description: Public listing search with distance calculation, driving time estimate, and multi-criteria filters.
Fetches single property. Landlord phone is shielded; landlord business name is revealed only to verified students.
Creates listing. Auto-calculates distanceFromSchoolKm and drivingTimeMinutes. Saves ID to {{propertyId}}.
Provider fetches all properties they own regardless of verification status.
Update property details. Note: editing core listing details sends status back to 'pending' for re-verification.
Deletes the listing owned by the provider.

item.name: 3. Inspection Slots
item.description: Availability windows, slot generation, and slot queries

request.description: Provider enters availability windows. Server breaks them into 30-minute bookable slots.
Retrieves all slots published by this provider.

item.name: Get Open Slots for Property (Verified Student)

request.description: Student views bookable open slots for an upcoming inspection. Requires verified student status.
Removes an unbooked availability slot.

item.name: 4. Inspections & Bookings
item.description: Booking slots, schedule management, attendance tracking, and accept/reject decisions

request.description: Atomically claims the chosen slot and creates a confirmed inspection. Triggers email notifications.
Student views all inspection bookings they have placed.
Provider views all inspection bookings across properties they manage.
Inspect details of a booking (student or provider).
Move 'requested' inspection to 'confirmed' with scheduledAt timestamp.
Provider declines an inspection before confirmation.
Reschedule inspection by moving to a new open slot. Releases previous slot.
Provider marks inspection as attended/completed. Unlocks student's ability to accept/reject and review.
Provider marks inspection as missed when student or party fails to attend.
Accepting creates a Transaction with total amount (rent + additional charges) and marks property as booked.
Rejection leaves the property available for other students.
Student cancels booking before completion. Frees the booked slot back to 'open'.

item.name: 5. Transactions
item.description: Payment and booking status lifecycle tracking

request.description: Student views all payment transactions linked to accepted inspections.
Provider views incoming booking transactions.
Fetches details of a specific transaction.
Transitions: pending -> in_progress/cancelled; in_progress -> completed/cancelled. Cancelling reopens property availability.

item.name: 6. Reviews & Ratings
item.description: Verified student reviews and ratings for inspected properties

request.description: Enforces verified review policy: only students with an 'accepted' inspection can review.
Returns all reviews and calculated average rating for a property.
List all reviews written by current student.
Author updates their rating or review comment.
Author deletes their review.

item.name: 7. Reports & Moderation Flags
item.description: User reporting for misleading listings or fraudulent behavior

request.description: Submit a report against a property or transaction.
List all reports filed by the current user.

item.name: 8. Admin Management
item.description: User moderation, student/provider verification approvals, listing queues, and platform analytics

request.description: List all users with verification status and role filters.
Suspends (or reactivates) account. Suspended users are immediately rejected by auth middleware.
Fetch pending student profile verifications.
Approves ('verified') or rejects student verification document. Sends email notification.
Fetch pending landlord accreditation and ID verifications.
Approves or rejects provider credentials.
Fetch pending property listings awaiting moderation before going live.
Approve listing to appear in public search, or reject with a reason to request landlord corrections.
Platform-wide view of all inspection bookings.
Fetch open dispute and fraud reports.
Update report status to 'reviewed' or 'resolved'.

item.name: 9. Notifications & Diagnostics
item.description: SMTP configuration tests and broadcast notifications

request.description: Verify that SMTP credentials and outbound email dispatch are functioning properly.
Send direct in-app and email announcement to a specific user.

item.name: 10. Schools & Campuses
item.description: Public endpoints to list and view tertiary institutions (used as proximity anchors for hostel listings), plus admin creation of new campuses.

query.description: Optional search keyword (e.g. unilag, yaba, ibadan)

request.description: Fetch all registered tertiary institutions. Automatically sets {{schoolId}} to the first returned campus.
Fetch details, name, and GeoJSON coordinates for a specific school using {{schoolId}}.
Admin registers a new tertiary campus with geographical latitude & longitude. Automatically saves the created school ID to {{schoolId}}.
